verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for an HR/payroll SaaS like Justworks, since such products can ship AI assistants or chat-driven commands. The evidence pack only documents click-through UI navigation (e.g., Pay > Make a Payment, Time Off > Policies > + Add policy), with no mention of an AI assistant, chat interface, or natural-language command capability. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.
